summary: Cuis is a modern, open‑source implementation of Smalltalk‑80 that provides a lightweight VM and an interactive IDE. It runs locally via a REPL or GUI and is built on its own language runtime without requiring external APIs. The tool is aimed at developers and learners who want a minimal, fast‑starting Smalltalk environment. Its standout strength is the quick startup and simplicity praised by the HN community (152 points, sentiment 8/10), while its main caveat is a limited library ecosystem and unclear support for modern AI integration.
